answer.text: Buying a broad basket of securities that mirror an index
Identifying specific undervalued securities to outperform the broader market
Holding cash and waiting for market corrections

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.79, active investing identifies specific securities to buy or sell, continuously evaluates the portfolio, buys securities priced below intrinsic value and sells above intrinsic value, and seeks returns above the broader asset class. The Trap: Option A describes passive investing (replicating an index). "Government bonds only" and "holding cash" do not match the p.79 active-investing definition. Note: The wording about specific-security selection, continuous evaluation, intrinsic-value-based buy/sell, and out-of-asset-class returns is taken directly from p.79.
